page.notes: The first letter of "Mathematicarum" is partly covered by an ink blot, so the M is doubtful. The dash after "de" in XXIV is a printed ornament or catchword-like mark, not a clear hyphen, so I left it out. The "dem" line of XVIII ends in a printed dash mark, which I read as a full stop.
